ideas.title: Investigation into Minneapolis shooting
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Alex Pretti by federal agents in Minneapolis. This story could explore potential police misconduct, the use of force, and the investigation process.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
What are the implications for police accountability?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it has significant implications for police accountability and community trust. The investigation should focus on determining the facts surrounding the shooting and whether proper protocols were followed.

ideas.title: FBI agent resignation and whistleblower suppression
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the resignation of an FBI agent who was trying to investigate an ICE officer who shot Renee Good. This story could explore potential whistleblower suppression and misconduct within law enforcement agencies.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the agent's resignation?
Was the agent pressured to drop the investigation?
What are the implications for whistleblower protection?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it has significant implications for whistleblower protection and accountability within law enforcement agencies. The investigation should focus on determining the facts surrounding the agent's resignation and whether proper protocols were followed.
